title: The 25 most haunted hotels in the United States in 2026: where to stay for Halloween
site_name: LRDH - le magazine des hôtels de luxe
excerpt: On 5 October 2026, Historic Hotels of America unveiled its 25 most haunted hotels in the United States.
content:
On 5 October 2026, Historic Hotels of America published its annual list of the 25 most haunted historic hotels in the United States, from Colonial Williamsburg (1750) to the Queen Mary ocean liner (1936). It is not a ranking: the hotels are listed by construction date. To join this programme of the National Trust for Historic Preservation, a hotel must be at least 50 years old and be designated a National Historic Landmark or listed in (or eligible for) the National Register of Historic Places. From more than 300 members, the Historic Hotels of America team chose these 25 for the quality and quantity of their legends, their willingness to share them and their Halloween 2026 offers.

In brief

  • 📜 The list · 25 historic hotels chosen by Historic Hotels of America, announced on 5 October 2026 and ordered by construction date, not by how haunted they are.
  • 🏛️ The criteria · at least 50 years old with federal heritage status, then plenty of legends, happily shared, and a Halloween 2026 offer.
  • 👻 A few legends · Kate Morgan’s room 3327 at the Hotel del Coronado, cabin B340 on the Queen Mary, room 325 at the Hawthorne Hotel in Salem.
  • 🎃 For Halloween · haunted tours, balls and costume parties, from Salem to Long Beach.
  • 💵 Prices checked · from 286 dollars (Queen Mary) to 687 dollars (Fairmont Sonoma) for two on the night of 31 October, as of 7 October 2026.
  • ⏳ Already full · the Williamsburg Inn and the Hawthorne Hotel on Halloween night, which falls on a Saturday in 2026.

The 25 haunted hotels on the 2026 list

These legends add to the unique character of the hotels, which treasure them, says Lawrence Horwitz, executive vice president of Historic Hotels of America and Historic Hotels Worldwide. The list follows the order of the press release, from the oldest building to the most recent; the one exception is the Hotel del Coronado (1888), which comes before the Jekyll Island Club (1887).

From these 25, we have picked ten hotels for a Halloween night, from Virginia to California. For each one, the price is that of the cheapest room for two adults on the night of Saturday 31 October to Sunday 1 November 2026, checked on 7 October 2026.

Williamsburg Inn, keys that jingle at night

Scroll

📍 Williamsburg, Virginia🏛️ 1937, houses from 1750💵 Full on 31 October

Opened in 1937, the Williamsburg Inn is the flagship of Colonial Williamsburg, billed as the largest living history museum in the country, an open-air site that also rents out colonial houses dating from 1750. According to Historic Hotels of America, guests at the Brick House Tavern hear keys jingling at night, see a man in colonial dress looking into an upstairs room and smell pipe tobacco; Thomas Jefferson is said to haunt the Market Square Tavern, where he lodged as a student.

In October, the Haunted Williamsburg tour recounts the colonial ghost stories of the 18th century. As of 7 October, the Inn was fully booked for the night of the 31st; the following night, 1 to 2 November, an Inn Superior room cost 659 dollars for two before tax, or 801 dollars all in.

Omni Bedford Springs and the girl in the apron

The Omni Bedford Springs, a spa resort since 1806 · © Omni Hotels & Resorts

📍 Bedford, Pennsylvania🏛️ 1806💵 $518 on 31 October

This spa resort favoured by American presidents has the fullest Halloween programme in our selection. According to Historic Hotels of America, figures in Victorian and Edwardian dress, including a woman climbing the stairs and a little girl in a white apron, appear around the historic indoor pool; the Buchanan Room, frequented by President James Buchanan, echoes with unexplained knocking, and cigar smoke drifts through the Daniel Webster Room.

The Haunted History Tours run from Wednesday to Sunday at 6pm and 7.30pm, all year round. On top of these come a Murder Mystery Dinner on 24 October, a costume party on the 31st and the Wandering Cauldron, a witchcraft-themed pop-up bar, in September and October. On the night of 31 October, a Deluxe Room with two double beds cost 518 dollars for two, taxes and fees included.

Omni Parker House: Harvey Parker still on duty

The Omni Parker House in Boston · © Omni Hotels & Resorts

📍 Boston, Massachusetts🏛️ 1855💵 $500 on 31 October

Billed as the oldest continuously operating hotel in the United States, and the birthplace of the Boston cream pie, the Parker House is said never to have lost its founder. According to Historic Hotels of America, Harvey Parker, who died in 1884, has been recognised by guests from his portraits; the tenth floor is associated with orbs, the third with Charles Dickens and the actress Charlotte Cushman, amid cigar smoke and lifts that stop on their own.

Advertisement

During the season, resident historian Susan Wilson gives her history tours a haunted twist. On the night of 31 October, a Traditional Room with a queen bed cost 500 dollars for two, taxes and fees included.

Little Maurice on the Monteleone’s 14th floor

Scroll

📍 New Orleans, Louisiana🏛️ 1886💵 $682 on 31 October

A grand family-run hotel in the French Quarter, on Royal Street, the Monteleone is famous for its revolving Carousel Bar. According to Historic Hotels of America, little Maurice Begere, who died of a fever at the hotel in the 1890s while his parents were at the French Opera House, is said to have appeared to his mother to tell her not to cry; guests still come across him on the 14th floor, as they do “Mrs. Clean”, a housekeeper who supposedly goes over the rooms again after the cleaning.

On the night of 31 October, a Traditional King Room cost 682 dollars for two, taxes and fees included. Elsewhere in town, the Fairmont New Orleans opens on 2 November.

Hotel del Coronado: who haunts room 3327?

Scroll

📍 Coronado, San Diego, California🏛️ 1888💵 $651 on 31 October

This Victorian timber grand hotel has faced the Pacific since 1888. According to Historic Hotels of America, Kate Morgan, who died at the hotel in 1892, never left: her room, 3327, is the most requested, and in 1992 a paranormal investigator documented more than 400 phenomena in room 3519 over a twelve-month study.

The medium James Van Praagh held a séance there in 2018. On the night of 31 October, a Victorian 1 King room cost 651 dollars for two, taxes and fees included.

Jekyll Island Club Resort, seven ghosts on record

The Jekyll Island Club Resort, opened in 1887 · © Jekyll Island Club Resort

📍 Jekyll Island, Georgia🏛️ 1887💵 $466 on 31 October

Once the winter club of the Rockefellers, Morgans and Pulitzers, on an unspoilt Georgia island, the Jekyll Island Club counts seven ghosts, according to Historic Hotels of America: a former president on the veranda at sunset, a woman in a blue evening gown looking for the waiter she danced with, a 1920s bellman delivering suits to grooms-to-be, and J.P. Morgan’s cigar in the early morning in his former apartment at Sans Souci Cottage.

Advertisement

In October, the Hotel History Tours take a haunted turn and stop at the spots said to be inhabited. On the night of 31 October, the Apartment cost 466 dollars for two, taxes and fees included.

Hawthorne Hotel and Salem’s room 325

Scroll

📍 Salem, Massachusetts🏛️ 1925💵 Full on 30 and 31 October

Less luxurious than the other addresses in our selection, the Hawthorne is nonetheless a must for Halloween: it stands in Salem, the town of the 1692 witch trials. According to Historic Hotels of America, room 325 is reputed to be the most haunted, with its cold spots and scent of freshly cut flowers; a female ghost haunts the sixth floor, room 621 turns its lights and taps on by itself, and in 1990 the hotel held a séance to contact Harry Houdini.

The “Phobia” Halloween Ball takes place on Saturday 24 October 2026, for over-21s only, and the Halloween Ball and Halloween Night packages are sold out; weekends require a two-night stay in October. As of 7 October, the nights of 30 and 31 October were fully booked; a Deluxe Double Room cost 380 dollars for two on the night of 1 to 2 November, taxes and fees included.

Fairmont Sonoma, Victoria on foggy evenings

Scroll

📍 Sonoma, California🏛️ 1927💵 $687 on 31 October

This Mission-style inn, in the heart of the Sonoma vineyards, has thermal baths fed by a hot spring. According to Historic Hotels of America, on foggy evenings Victoria, one of the valley’s first European settlers, walks the corridors in period dress; an old man is said to haunt a room in the original building, and the Round Room is reputed to be one of the most haunted rooms in California.

On the night of 31 October, a Fairmont King Room cost 687 dollars for two, taxes and fees included, the highest price in our selection that night.

Hermosa Inn: “Lon did it”, say the staff

Scroll

📍 Paradise Valley, Arizona🏛️ 1935💵 $549 before tax on 31 October

This intimate adobe hacienda at the foot of Camelback Mountain keeps its builder’s name alive at its restaurant, LON’s. According to Historic Hotels of America, cowboy painter Lon Megargee, who built the house with his own hands, is still around: a cowboy’s reflection in the casita mirrors, tools tidied away in the cellar, a mysterious Pink Lady; staff close every incident with “Lon did it”.

A self-guided ghost tour is available on request at check-in. On the night of 31 October, a Rancho Casita cost 549 dollars for two before taxes and fees, at the public rate on the hotel’s website.

Sleeping aboard the Queen Mary, cabin B340

Scroll

📍 Long Beach, California🏛️ 1936💵 $286 on 31 October

Here you sleep aboard an Art Deco Cunard liner moored in Long Beach, 90 years after its maiden voyage. According to Historic Hotels of America, the front desk receives reports about cabin B340 (flickering lights, a running tap, portholes opening on their own), watertight door no. 13, a lady in white dancing in the lounges and the former first-class pool, described as a “vortex”.

The annual Dark Harbor event, guided paranormal tours and seasonal experiences fill the autumn calendar. On the night of 31 October, a Standard Room with a double bed cost 286 dollars for two, taxes and fees included, the lowest price in our selection.

Our pick

Our pick for every kind of guest

  • For a fright · the Hotel del Coronado and Kate Morgan’s room 3327, or the seven ghosts of the Jekyll Island Club.
  • For luxury · the Fairmont Sonoma Mission Inn and its thermal baths, or the Del, facing the Pacific.
  • For couples · The Hermosa Inn, its adobe casitas and the patio at LON’s at sunset.
  • For Salem · the Hawthorne Hotel, full on the 31st: aim for the ball on 24 October or the night of 1 November.
  • For a full programme · the Omni Bedford Springs, with its Murder Mystery Dinner, costume party and Haunted History Tours.
  • In the city · the Omni Parker House in Boston or the Monteleone, in the French Quarter of New Orleans.
  • On a budget · the Queen Mary, 286 dollars for two on Halloween night, with Dark Harbor on board.

Booking a Halloween night in the United States

Practical information

  • 🗓️ A Saturday night · in 2026, Halloween night runs from Saturday 31 October to Sunday 1 November; as of 7 October, the Williamsburg Inn and the Hawthorne Hotel were already fully booked.
  • ⏳ Book early · in Salem, the Hawthorne Hotel’s Halloween Ball (23 to 26 October) and Halloween Night (30 and 31 October) packages are sold out, with a two-night minimum at weekends in October.
  • 🎟️ Key dates · the “Phobia” ball on 24 October in Salem, a costume party on the 31st at the Omni Bedford Springs, Dark Harbor on the Queen Mary.
  • 💵 Prices · checked on 7 October 2026, taxes and fees included, except at The Hermosa Inn (before tax).
